summary: Generate internal typed Rust notice models from the dependency-closed client schema, rejecting unsupported schema constructs.

replay.detail: No stored claims or projections change.

compatibility.detail: Models are compiled by internal conformance tests only; no public library exports, resource arms, operations, actions, watch selectors or capabilities are added. Decoding enforces schema constants, bounds, IDs and dates.

recovery.detail: Rollback removes only internal generated models and their conformance proof.
